commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Haste
{1}, {T}: Add {U}{B}{R}. Spend this mana only to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
When Cormela dies, return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.

source_basis.known_approval_project_exceptions: Explicit user approval after the SHA-bound complete gate returned APPROVAL_READY: exactly 100 cards, 100 distinct names, Grixis color identity, fresh per-card Oracle verification, current official Commander legality, independent rules verification, zero project exceptions, and zero gate errors.

strategy.primary: cEDH instant/sorcery combo: Cormela's hasty restricted UBR mana pays for spell chains, and her death trigger loops with sacrifice outlets plus reanimation/cloning (Saw in Half, Goryo's Vengeance, Shallow Grave, Demonic Gifts, Molten Duplication + Birgi).
strategy.secondary: Commander-independent cEDH failovers: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation/Tainted Pact, Underworld Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze or Wheel, Tendrils of Agony storm.

role.advances_plan: Cormela is a ritual on a hasty body and the recursion piece of a dozen Spellbook loops; most of the deck's infinites name her.
role.honest_note: The compact Thassa's Oracle and Breach wins don't need her, which is correct for cEDH resilience; the ledger keeps them as failovers, not the identity.

identity_core.why: Hasty spell ritual and the death-trigger half of most loops.
Two-card commander loop with any mana-positive ritual.
Copies Cormela for the Birgi loop and Dualcaster for the token loop.
Instant-speed reanimation half of the altar loop.
